metadata.name: Worldspace map renderer - references
metadata.description:
Find all references with the desired base forms in a given worldspace, and render a map of their locations. References are displayed as colored dots on an image of the worldspace's terrain, and you can change the color on a per-base-form basis post-render.
This script does not render worldspace terrain; you must pre-render it, and place the render in the script package's "pre-rendered" subfolder. Expected filename format is "A-B.png", where "A" is the worldspace's editor ID, and "B" is the name (including extension) of the file that creates the worldspace (e.g. "Tamriel-Skyrim.esm.png").
